events.title: Snot Pop! launches 2 November – Play the free demo during Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Snot Pop! is in Steam Next Fest! Hello snot fans! 👋 The sewers officially open on 2 November 2026. The free demo is out now and ready to play during Steam Next Fest. Let's get popping! Blow snot bubbles, trap the Mouldlings, pop them for combos and see how far you get. events.title: Snot Pop! Free Demo available NOW!
events.summary: Snot Pop! Free Demo is available NOW!Grab your loincloth, pop some mouldlings. The wait is over, and the sewers of Snotland are officially open for business.The free, playable demo for Snot Pop! is live on Steam right now. If you have been craving pure, unadulterated late 80s through early 90s vertical arcade platforming - complete with snot bubbles, foul-tempered purple mould, and tight, hair-raising controls: your weekend side quest have arrived.
